control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: near hit - thermal exposure at P-7111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-7111, PT-7111 and TK-7102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-7111 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 9 October 2004 a near hit was recorded on P-7111, PT-7111 and TK-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
